They were led by first year head coach [[Tony Stubblefield]] and played their home games at [[Wintrust Arena]] in [[Chicago|Chicago, Illinois]] as members of the [[Big East Conference]]. ==Previous season== In a season limited due to the ongoing [[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|COVID-19 pandemic]], the [[2020–21 DePaul Blue Demons men's basketball team|Blue Demons]] finished the [[2020–21 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2020–21 season]] 5–14, 2–13 in [[2020–21 Big East Conference men's basketball season|Big East play]] to finish in last place. They defeated [[2020–21 Providence Friars men's basketball team|Providence]] in the first round of the [[2021 Big East men's basketball tournament|Big East tournament]] before losing to [[2020–21 UConn Huskies men's basketball team|UConn]] in the quarterfinals. After finishing in last place in the Big East for a fifth consecutive year, the school fired head coach [[Dave Leitao]] on March 15, 2021.{{Cite web|date=2021-03-15|title=DePaul fires Leitao after 5 straight seasons in last|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/31070716/sources-depaul-blue-demons-fire-dave-leitao-5-straight-last-place-finishes|access-date=2021-09-20|website=ESPN.com|language=en}}
